question: Tomara Rajputs were defeated in the twelfth century by the Chauhans of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ajmer.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tomara Rajputs were defeated in the twelfth century by the Chauhans of ****Ajmer.**
 
• The Tomara was an Indian dynasty that ruled parts of present-day Delhi and Haryana during the 9th-12th century.
 
• Tomara dynasty:
 
 
• The dynasty ruled India during the 8th-12th century.
 
• Their kingdoms were expanded and ruled parts of present-day Delhi and Haryana.
 
• Anangpur was the capital.
 
• 
 According to a 14th-century inscription Tomara dynasty built Dhillika (modern-day Delhi) a city in the Haryana region.

 
 
• The city was fortified by a wall called Lal Kot built by Anangpal Tomar. 
 
 
 
• Anangpal was the last king of the dynasty.
 
• He handed over the throne of Delhi to his son-in-law Prithviraj Chauhan.
